introduction.value: Mollie Mueller used Grok Bot to sort LinkedIn messages after maternity leave, restore her banner, email a vendor for a quote, renew parking permits and find toddler classes.

method.value: Mollie Mueller set up several Grok Bots with ongoing roles (Chief of Staff, Life Admin, LinkedIn Bot). They sign into sites from their own computer. It also renewed parking permits and emailed tennis instructors.

outcome.value: Over three weeks it finished tasks instead of only advising. Weaknesses: its writing is weak, and its generated artwork was worse than ChatGPT's. Toddler class registration awaits her decision.

source_text.body:
Handle LinkedIn backlog and life admin tasks with a bot
Mollie Mueller used Grok Bot to sort LinkedIn messages after maternity leave, restore her banner, email a vendor for a quote, renew parking permits and find toddler classes.
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
Mollie Mueller set up several Grok Bots with ongoing roles (Chief of Staff, Life Admin, LinkedIn Bot). They sign into sites from their own computer. On LinkedIn the bot sorted messages and swapped her banner back. For swag, it researched vendors and emailed one a quote request with her artwork, without showing her a draft. It also renewed parking permits and emailed tennis instructors.
How it went
Over three weeks it finished tasks instead of only advising. Weaknesses: its writing is weak, and its generated artwork was worse than ChatGPT's. Toddler class registration awaits her decision.
Worth knowing
It sent the vendor email without asking for review, and she gave it her decades-old personal Gmail. She paid over $200 a month, but cheaper plans now include it.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Help me clear my life admin backlog. Start with my LinkedIn messages: sort them into reply now, reply later and ignore, and draft replies for the first group. Then do these tasks: [email [vendor] to request a quote for [job], renew [parking permit or similar], find [kind of classes] near [my area] for a [age] child]. Finish with a summary of what is done and what still needs me. Before sending any email, submitting a form or making a payment, pause and show me exactly what you are about to do.
Original source: https://molliemueller.com/blog/i-can-t-believe-i-m-saying-this-but-i-love-grok-bot
